events.note: NASA global P1 12:57:23.5 UT, printed with ΔT 84.3 s. The penumbra's northern limit crosses northern South America and West Africa, well south of Philadelphia. USNO's solar eclipse API returned HTTP 500 for every 2027 date on the retrieval date, so NASA's map is the authority here
